It seems we're having some technical issues with the tools. Let me solve this problem based on my knowledge of chemistry:

Naphthalene (C10H8) is a polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon consisting of two fused benzene rings. 

The carbon atoms in naphthalene are sp² hybridized, as they form the aromatic ring system. Each carbon atom has three sp² hybrid orbitals that form sigma bonds (two with adjacent carbon atoms and one with a hydrogen atom), and one unhybridized p orbital that participates in the aromatic π-bond system.

The hydrogen atoms in naphthalene are bonded to these sp² hybridized carbon atoms. However, hydrogen atoms themselves do not undergo hybridization. Hydrogen has only a 1s orbital and does not have enough orbitals to hybridize. The hydrogen atoms form sigma bonds with the sp² hybrid orbitals of the carbon atoms.

Therefore, the hydrogen atoms in naphthalene do not undergo hybridization.
